settings.text:
What makes FLAVE Granola special?

FLAVE Granola is handcrafted in small batches using whole grain oats, pure honey, almonds, and other carefully selected ingredients. Every batch is baked to a perfectly golden crunch with no artificial flavors or preservatives.

Does your granola contain refined sugar?

No. Our Honey Crunch Granola is naturally sweetened with pure honey and contains no refined sugar.

Is FLAVE Granola ready to eat?

Yes. FLAVE Granola is fully baked and ready to enjoy straight from the pack. No preparation required.

How can I enjoy FLAVE Granola?

Enjoy it with yogurt, milk, smoothie bowls, fresh fruit, or simply as a crunchy snack straight from the pack.

Is your granola only for breakfast?

Not at all. While it's perfect for breakfast, FLAVE Granola is just as delicious as a snack or sprinkled over yogurt, smoothie bowls, fruit, or desserts.

How should I store my granola?

Store in a cool, dry place and reseal the pouch after each use to keep it fresh and crunchy.

How long does it stay fresh?

When stored properly in its sealed pouch, FLAVE Granola stays fresh for several months. Please refer to the best-before date printed on the pack.

Does it contain nuts?

Yes. Our Honey Crunch Granola contains almonds and is made in a facility where other allergens may be present.

Is it suitable for vegetarians?

Yes. Our Honey Crunch Granola is suitable for vegetarians.

Where can I buy FLAVE Granola?

You can order directly from our website (Shop FLAVE) or find FLAVE at our retail partners listed on the (Retail Partners) page.

Do you offer wholesale?

Yes! We'd love to partner with cafés, bakeries, specialty food stores, and other retailers. Please get in touch through our contact page to discuss wholesale opportunities.

Do you offer different flavors?

Yes. FLAVE is growing, and we're excited to introduce more delicious flavors. Visit our Shop FLAVE page to see our latest range.
